assertion: SVG direction and unicode-bidi reorder glyphs while x/y lists still address logical characters. Text anchors respect direction; independent positioned spans, mixed Hebrew/Latin runs and textLength remain deterministic.

browser.reason: Chrome and Firefox agree on logical character coordinates and directional text anchors. WebKit incorrectly joins separately positioned RTL tspan chunks; Chrome is selected after checking the logical positions against SVG text chunk rules. Native differences are confined to glyph antialiasing edges (4628 pixels, maximum channel delta 166); positions and glyph ordering are also asserted independently in unit tests.
